findings: Committed row/asset-document deletion precedes process-local deferred external effects
Local File.rm result ignored; unsafe Blobstore.delete path also returns:ok
Process dictionary effects removed before callbacks; outer transaction owner flushes on commit and clears on rollback
Local return correction alone does not create atomic durable intent/retry/ownership reservation
C103 read-sharing handles block named delete/rename; closed observations do not lease a future object
Metadata can change while sharing is held; changed result has no digest/identity authority
proposedNext: One owned-local durable deletion operation with transactional intent, truthful effect state and identity/reservation/restart proof; receipt semantics must be explicit before implementation
limits: Bounded source/caller review only, not a repository-wide audit
Remote effects/exactly-once guarantees and historical intent remain unproven
